title: Row level security in two statements
why_it_matters: Without it, anyone with your public key may read your table.
explanation: Row level security makes the database check a rule for every row. First you turn it on for the table. Then a policy says who may do what. This policy lets a signed-in user read only their own notes.
try_it: Turn RLS on for a test table, then try a select with no policy and see zero rows.
